title: Fix texture type validation error when using auto exposure with XR.
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes #124769

Explicitly passes the left eye texture to the luminance reduction shader to fix the texture type validation error. It already worked like this before on GPU drivers that didn't care about the texture type, so this is more of a regression fix. #69000 would likely require a separate fix with a very different implementation.

## Additional information

N/A.
